title: Closed contact with stick perturbation
source: Closed-form uniform-layer shear mode with bonded contact, shown with substitution in README.md.

quantities.reason: For the prescribed 1% compression, λ = 1 − 0.01. The closed stick shear mode has K = 500 λ² + 4 N/m per layer and M = 1/3 kg, hence f = sqrt(3(500 λ² + 4))/(2π). The stated tolerance covers the documented finite-element contact closure/penetration tolerance and the resulting small stretch perturbation, rather than changing the closed-form reference.
